checks.detail: Three resource source files match execution freeze; old eight synthetic examples cover bracket bounds, missing counter, reset, generation change, uncovered envelope, true zero, overlapping clock and unknown KiB column. Reuse does not certify the new adapter or new scope.

Completed pipeline precedes the audit; exact 16 group directories and controllers, 48 raw files / 25,008,638 bytes match report hashes and retained stat identity. Owned resource audit exited 0 with its process group absent.

16 terminal group decisions and controller/HTTP/monitor receipts precede audit; 64 unique cases match ordered scope and sequence hashes, response IDs, prompt/output hashes, input/output counts and saved client boundaries; each group has four envelopes.

Independently read 3812 raw/CSV row pairs and 176 retained endpoints; recomputed 192 endpoint deltas and 256 sample interval bounds without importing or invoking the frozen auditor. Exact PID/start ticks, cgroup generation, device identity, monotonicity and 5 second uncertainty were checked in every reported known span.

All 16 memory summaries match raw final cgroup observations, sampled cgroup maxima and KiB-to-byte/NVIDIA CSV peaks; missing counters and GPU skips remain absent, PSI and live file cache remain UNKNOWN. No independent memory peaks are added.

known_issues.detail: Cgroup parent-device I/O and PID read_bytes disagree in all 64 request windows; no zero-delta request plateau in this run. Low-count/near-platform behavior is retained as measured, without substituting PID or partition values.

Seven groups have sampled memory.current greater than their retained final memory.peak. Preserve both platform values; the largest sampled current is 253952 B above configured 16 GiB while final memory.peak excess is at most 16384 B. Neither column alone proves a strict no-overshoot bound.

NVIDIA/process/cgroup/cache views overlap and are not a synchronized deduplicated physical union. Whole-machine 54 GB remains INDETERMINATE; NVIDIA peak neither certifies PASS nor an overall physical-memory FAIL.
PSI unavailable, no live model-file-cache observations, GPU scheduled skips retained, four process-I/O misses at shutdown. Known request brackets do not erase missing lifecycle observations.

limits: All I/O deltas cover the client process envelope including launch/teardown; not pure HTTP, prefill, decode, SSD expert-only bytes or a causal cache-cost partition.

PID read_bytes is process storage I/O; rchar is logical reads; the model partition 259:1 includes background traffic and cgroup 259:0 is a distinct accounting view. Do not add parent disk and partition.
Memory values are whole-service lifecycle peaks, not per-request peaks. Zero observed OOM and cgroup swap do not establish no pressure or no whole-machine swap.
Four service repetitions per condition; positions remain separate and 64 windows are not 64 independent service replicates. No performance acceptance or revised old NO_GO conclusion.

This review independently checked the selected resource provenance and arithmetic only. It reuses previous full execution review and does not rerun synthetic tests, auditor, controllers or final live cleanup.
